This place was amazing! The room was clean and comfortable. I enjoyed the private patio where I was able to read and enjoy some peace and quiet. My only complaint was that the bed was a bit too soft for me. That is my personal preference.

Most of all, this was my first solo trip and I felt safe. The food from the restaurant was delicious. Austin, Riley, and Zach from the bar were amazing! Very patient and got every order right! Also, the DJ that was there on Friday night made the ambiance so much better.

The pool and jacuzzi area was nice, comfortable, and clean. And the spa was sooooo relaxing. I got the 75 min body scrub with the added on foot treatment. It was nice to have the complimentary champgane after. Overall i really enjoyed my stay and can't wait to come back! The Scott is alright with me.

It seems they sell day passes so there were people everywhere. I must say the pool staff was excellent. 
Hotel is visually pretty, great for everyone taking selfies everywhere. It’s just not for us.

inCorpusNuggets.sourceText:
Lipstick on a Pig This iconic Scottsdale Boutique hotel has outlived it prime!  Let me start by saying what a lovely welcoming front entrance with the classic car and bicycles.  The Lobby was beautiful with its Havana vibe.  The front desk staff was welcoming, and check in was prompt.  
We went to room 116, and were please with the size, layout and decor, but it was quite weathered.  The shower had poor drainage and there was a loud and constant whirring noise (not associated w the A/C), keeping us awake all night…even  noise canceling AirPods with music could not block the noise.  They move our room at 5 am.  Room 550, consistently decorated.  We had not tried the A/C until bedtime (our bad), now we had a different, and even louder noise.  Exhausted from the day we turned it off for the night but the room got stuffy. Back to reception…maintenance fixed the A/C, no more noise, but not blowing cold air any longer.  There was a room service tray on the floor in the hall for 24+ hours.
Taking advantage of the live music and energy of The Canal club after returning from dinner we found the service to be horribly understaffed.  Couldn’t order a second round and unbussed tables all around the lobby, we had to search someone out to pay.
SO DISAPPOINTING…. Don’t waste your money.

Not for business travelers! If you happen to be anything other than a giddy untraveled 23 year old bride with implants, or part of her 20 person instagram team, this is not the place for you. I am a very experienced business traveler who was simply looking for somewhere luxurious and peaceful. All I found were teams of chatty bridesmaids. It’s almost hilariously overrun in that way. it is not at all peaceful except in the rooms. But I am not trying to pay $457 / night plus a $100 resort fee to be confined to a bedroom just hear myself think. 

If you are not in your early 20’s and will not be blown away by a nice but super basic swimming pool, this is not the place. If you’re a man looking to watch women trip over themselves to impress each other while you crack up, it could be fun. 

The wifi doesn’t work...got a hotspot? 

But they do have a DJ in the lobby... Just need to add a spinning strobe light and maybe hand out selfie sticks upon check in. 

I wish I had gone to something like the Garden Inn or a Residence Inn or maybe even an old run down Sheraton
Instead. Ha. Torture. 

One upside was the pillow. Pretty decent pillows. 

Caveat emptor...

3 night stay at the Scott Resort, Scottsdale  AZ. This is a very relaxing resort.   The staff are very efficient - especially the Food & Beverage manager Hannah Peppler.   The staff really moved around the pool making sure we were all served efficiently.    Food and beverage at pool perfect.   Dining room also a great experience.   The lobby is extremely spacious and you get a private feeling.    There are 2 pools and one jacuzzi.    They have live entertainment on weekends.  The patio rooms have a private area to sit and the rooms are comfortable and roomy.    The shower has plenty of hot water.
I recommend the Cuban sandwich.      The pool rooms are a better choice.

There is also plenty of comfortable stylish seating in the courtyard for enjoying a nice day or night outside. The hotel staff was very accommodating and the hotel even offered shuttle services around town. We stayed in a king patio room, which was very spacious in the bedroom. The only cons are the rooms are not as updated as the hotel website shows. The bathrooms were sacrificed to accommodate such a large bedroom area. The ceilings are maybe 6ft tall. Overall, I would recommend the Scott if you're looking to socialize with friends or enjoy being outside at the pool areas. The bar inside the hotel was great and there was live music in the lobby. The had plenty of seating and fun games spread around the lobby. Would absolutely book again.

inCorpusNuggets.sourceText:
A little disappointing I really wanted to stay at this hotel as I thought it‘s design was really unique and inspiring, which it definitely is. However, while the design lived up to our expectations, some other aspects did not…

First the positive aspects:
- rooms are nice and comfy
- beautiful gardens with lots of cozy places to hang out and fire lit in evening giving the place a lot of atmosphere
- breakfast was really good with a selection of unusual dishes, too and fair prices
- free shuttle around town in an SUV from 6 to 11 pm
- central location - a 20 minute stroll away from the Old Town of Scottsdale with lots and lots of restaurants and shops nearby

Potential for improvement
- the price performance ratio is completely out of place!!! we got a particularly “good“ deal for 750$ for two nights which is still a hell lot of money. on top, you have to pay a 45$ daily resort fee!! no complimentary water in the room (not even upon arrival). no newspapers, shoeshine service or whatsoever. turndown service only upon request. you pay for luxury, but receive pretty much standard.
- while the inside of the hotel is very nice, the outside isn‘t quite so much. You have very busy roads surrounding the hotel which means your rooms facing the outside are quite noisy. It feels rather like a motel and your views are the parking lots surrounding the hotels.
- service was mostly not existing. Reception staff was fine, but breakfast service was a little clumsy. At the lounge, we were not even served our after-dinner drinks and ended up getting them at the bar ourselves although lots of servers were around.

All in all, we were a bit disappointed. The place could be awesome with some more effort taken.
